segments.text: Hello. Am I speaking with Meera? This is Rahul from Fictional Homes. You filled in our form about a two-bedroom flat. Is this a good time for five minutes?
Yes. Hi, Rahul. I have a few minutes. I'm on my way home.
Thank you. I'll keep it short. Can I ask, what made you start looking right now?
We're renting at the moment. My husband and I have a baby coming in March, so we want our own place before that.
Congratulations. That helps me a lot. So you'd wanna move in by early next year?
Ideally by February. Not later than that.
Got it. The flat you saw online, the two bedroom on the higher floors, is that the size you have in mind or do you need a third room?
Two bedrooms is enough, but we'd like a proper balcony and a good school close by for later.
That makes sense. What budget have you and your husband agreed on, roughly?
We were thinking around eighty lac, all in. The listing said eighty-five, which is a stretch.
I understand. Eighty-five is for the higher floors. The same layout on the fourth floor comes to about seventy-nine, with the same balcony. And our home loan partner can do the paperwork for you.
Seventy-nine is much better, but honestly, my worry is the commute. My husband works on the other side of the city.
That's fair. Most of our buyers ask the same. The new metro station opens about ten minutes' walk away next year, and there's a direct bus today. Would it help if he saw the route himself?
Yes. He won't decide without seeing it.
Then the best next step is a site visit with both of you. You can see the fourth-floor flat and the balcony, and we can drive the route to the station. Does Saturday morning work?
Saturday is good. Maybe eleven?
Saturday at eleven. Perfect. I'll send you the location and the fourth-floor plan on WhatsApp today. Is this number on WhatsApp?
Yes, this one.
Great. Just so I'm ready, apart from the commute and the budget, is there anything else that would stop you going ahead?
The possession date. We can't wait two years.
The fourth-floor tower is ready to move in by January. I'll bring the completion letter on Saturday so you can see it.
Okay. That would really help.
Wonderful. So, Saturday at eleven, both of you, the fourth-floor flat, the route to the station, and the January possession letter. I'll message you within the hour. Thank you, Meera.
Thank you, Rahul. See you Saturday.
